checks.title: After Effects script approval (trust) state is unproven
checks.detail: whether After Effects will run scripts from this package's session folder without a per-location approval cannot be verified without launching AE; on AE 26.5+ an unapproved script is refused (-1708) with a modal. The approval granularity (folder vs script) is unproven (#125).
checks.remedy: On the first launch, approve the session's staging folder in After Effects (Edit > Preferences > Scripting & Expressions) when AE prompts. Until the approval granularity is measured, a new session directory may need its own approval; keep one sessionRoot per project to minimise prompts.

checks.title: After Effects scripting component is unproven
checks.detail: the ExtendScript component's install locations are not verified for the Windows install layout, so whether the scripting component is usable is unproven
checks.remedy: Launch After Effects once and run a trivial script; if AE reports the Scripting plugin is not installed, repair the install through Creative Cloud.

checks.title: Per-user Scripts/Startup folder state
checks.detail: the per-user Scripts/Startup folder (%APPDATA%\Adobe\After Effects\<ver>\Scripts\Startup) is documented but its execution is unproven on Windows; G0 evidence covers macOS only
checks.remedy: No action for AfterEffects.launch — the folder matters only for the in-AE dispatcher transport (#127).

checks.title: After Effects is already running
checks.detail: After Effects is already running: pid 49200 (session 1); a local launch attaches to it and reports ownership "attached"
checks.remedy: Nothing to do — AfterEffects.launch reuses the running instance and close() will not quit it. Quit AE yourself first only if you want a fresh instance.
